Even commentators called out how stupid that is. They have been talking for 10 minutes on the live feed how stupid of a decision it was and how they they threw away a clear podium.
So they told Lewis to thrash his tyres for a two stop, didn’t tell Charles to let him past when he had pace, then they let Lewis wreck his tyres, and then didn’t box during the VSC?

Great stuff Ferrari. I can't stand this team anymore. Fucking fire Fred Vasseur, the whole strategy team and both race engineers. This is hands down the worst strategy team on the grid. It's unbelievable.
